On 2026-06-18 we added 8 seats (from 12 -> 20) and expected a prorated charge for the remainder of June. The invoice shows a full-month charge for the 8 seats rather than a pro rata amount, which has resulted in an overcharge on our side.

Additionally, VAT has been applied on the full amount. ArkBridge is VAT-registered in the EU and expects reverse-charge treatment on B2B services — I can provide our VAT ID and billing details below.

Can you please:
- Confirm how the proration was calculated
- Issue a credit note for the overcharged amount (and a corrected invoice)
- Confirm whether this will delay our payment processing or if we should withhold payment until the corrected invoice is available

VAT details:
ArkBridge S.L.

Hi Clara / Priyom,

Apologies for the trouble — I pulled the billing run and here’s what happened: the seat upgrade was processed in our provisioning system after the June billing cut (our billing job ran on 2026-06-18 23:50 UTC). Because the seat change landed after the cutoff, our platform defaulted to billing the full additional seat-month rather than prorating. That’s a backend ordering edge-case we should have caught.

I attached a short proration_workbook_arkbridge.xlsx showing the calculation; summary below (net amounts):
- Previous seats: 12 (monthly rate per seat: EUR 450)
- New seats: 20
- Effective date of change: 2026-06-18
- Billing cycle day: last day of month (pro rata days remaining: 13 of 30)
- Expected prorated net for 8 seats: 8 * 450 * (13/30) = EUR 1,560.00
- Charged (system): 8 * 450 = EUR 3,600.00
- Overcharge (net): EUR 2,040.00

VAT handling: thanks for the VAT ID. For B2B EU customers with a valid VAT ID and a taxable place of supply that triggers reverse‑charge, the invoice should be zero‑rated for VAT and the reverse‑charge note included. We will:
- Void the original invoice and issue a credit note for the overcharge (gross amount including VAT as originally charged)
- Issue a corrected invoice that applies reverse-charge (VAT note) and charges only the prorated net amount

Proposed timeline: credit note + corrected invoice within 48 business hours once we have final confirmation of the VAT ID and billing address (you provided both, thank you).

I attached the draft corrected invoice (PDF stub) and the proration workbook.

Next steps (open):
- Clara: please confirm VAT ID exactly as you want it printed on the credit note/invoice (you sent ESX-91234567 — I’ll use that unless you tell me otherwise)
- Priyom: I’ll generate the credit note and corrected invoice and push to payments.redwood.ai; I’ll also tag the HubSpot deal DB-5821 so finance can match payments.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Billing Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: proration_workbook_arkbridge.xlsx; draft_corrected_invoice_5821.pdf)
